requirements.title: Statement functions are functions defined by one statement
requirements.definition: A function defined by a single statement is a statement function.

pending.statement-function-single-statement-defi: In a program declare integer f, i; define statement function f(i)=i+1, evaluate f(41) into a variable initialized to -10, and expect 42.
